metadata.name: aegis402
metadata.description: Aegis402: Trustless Bug Bounty Vaults (Commit-Reveal), Whitehat Reputation & x402 Audit Attestations on Solana

instructions.name: approve_and_payout
docs: Protocol authority approves a Committed/Revealed/Disputed finding, releases rent-safe SOL
from PDA escrow, and awards anti-Sybil reputation.

instructions.name: close_bounty
docs: Protocol authority closes the bounty vault ONLY when zero unresolved findings remain
AND any post-Reveal anti-poaching cooldown window has expired, sweeping 100% of escrow SOL.

instructions.name: create_bounty
docs: Protocol creates a trustless SOL Bug Bounty Vault backed by a rent-safe PDA escrow.

instructions.name: initialize_arbitrator
docs: Initializes the cluster-wide arbitration oracle keypair once.
On BPFLoaderUpgradeable (Devnet/Mainnet), cryptographically enforces that ONLY the
program's upgrade authority can initialize `arb_config` (100% immune to front-running).

instructions.name: raise_dispute
docs: Whitehat challenges an unfair rejection of a cryptographically Revealed finding.
Re-locks `pending_findings += 1` (freezing escrow withdrawal) and opens on-chain arbitration.

instructions.name: record_audit_attestation
docs: Seals an x402 security audit attestation permanently on Solana Devnet.
Inspects the Solana Instructions Sysvar for a preceding Ed25519Program signature from
AEGIS_ATTESTER_PUBKEY over the exact canonical report+source hash payload.

instructions.name: reject_finding
docs: Protocol authority rejects an invalid/duplicate finding.
ANTI-POACHING GAME THEORY: If the finding was already cryptographically `Revealed`,
rejecting it triggers a 24h `VaultCooldown` lock blocking `close_bounty` so the
researcher cannot be front-run by an atomic `[reject_finding, close_bounty]` bundle
and has guaranteed time to invoke `raise_dispute`!

instructions.name: resolve_dispute
docs: Independent AEGIS Arbitration Oracle resolves a disputed finding (authorized via direct
arbitrator signature OR inline Ed25519Program Sysvar signature). If upheld, releases the
bounty directly from PDA escrow to the researcher even if the protocol owner refuses to pay.

instructions.name: reveal_finding
docs: Whitehat cryptographically reveals PoC summary + salt; Solana runtime verifies SHA-256 on-chain!

instructions.name: submit_finding_commit
docs: Whitehat commits SHA-256(poc_summary || "||" || salt) on-chain.
Locks cryptographic timestamp proof without leaking exploit details, and prevents protocol rug-pull.

instructions.name: top_up_bounty
docs: Anyone (protocol treasury or LI.FI bridge recipient) can top up an active bounty pool.
